blocks.en: Appendix I Blinded Expert Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录一 失明专家评价

blocks.en: This appendix gives the protocol, reliability, and control analyses behind Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 本附录提供了表1后面的协议、可靠性和控制分析。

blocks.en: Thirty-eight evaluators with MS or PhD degrees in the mathematical, computational, or natural sciences, recruited and screened separately from the authors (31 through a screened crowd platform, 7 verified in person), rated 60 blinded items: ten per dataset, stratified by the contrastive score κ t \kappa_{t} . Each evaluator saw only the research question, the candidate explanations, and the statistical evidence from the executed analysis, with the alternatives in random order; our system’s beliefs, its resolution label, and the pointwise verdict were never shown. Each item was rated by at least 4 evaluators (median 8). The four questions per item were (Q1) which explanation the evidence supports, with the extra options “none of these is supported” and “cannot tell”; (Q2) whether the alternatives are mutually exclusive and cover the plausible explanations, with options for a missing explanation, overlap, or both; (Q3) whether the result is worth reporting; and (Q4) whether the chosen variables and test fit the question. We score items by majority vote and count no majority, “cannot tell,” and “none” as disagreement with our system’s explanation. Five submissions were excluded under a rule fixed at the first exclusion (one incomplete session and four evaluators who missed both attention checks). Restricting to the 30 evaluators who caught every attention check lowers the overall agreement from 71.7% to 68.3%, so inattentive raters do not carry the result. Expert evaluations were collected with informed consent and kept confidential; the information concerned our methods and scientific outputs, not the evaluators as individuals. Under our institution’s IRB guidance, this activity does not constitute human-subjects research and therefore did not require IRB review.
blocks.zh: 与作者分开征聘和筛选的38名具有数学、计算或自然科学硕士或博士学位的评价员(31人通过一个经过筛选的人群平台,7人亲自核实),被评为60个失明项目:每个数据集10个,按对比分值=t\kappa_{t}。 每个评估者只看到研究问题、候选解释以及执行分析的统计证据,以及随机排列的替代方法;我们系统的信念、它的解析标签和点性判断从未显示。 每个项目至少有4名评价员(中间8名)评分。 每个项目的四个问题是(问题1)解释证据所支持的,另外的选项是“没有支持这些选项”和“不能说”;(问题2)备选案文是否相互排斥,是否涵盖可信的解释,是否有缺少解释、重叠或两者兼有的选择;(问题3)结果是否值得报告;以及(4)选定的变量和测试是否符合问题。 我们通过多数投票对项目进行评分,不把多数、“不能说”和“没有”算作不同意我们制度的解释。 根据第一次排除时确定的规则,有5份呈文被排除在外(一份不完整的会议和4名评价员错过了对注意力的检查)。 限制在30名受到关注的评价员检查后,总体协议率从71.7%降至68.3%,因此不积极评分者不带结果。 专家评价是在知情同意的情况下收集的,并保密;有关信息涉及我们的方法和科学产出,而不是作为个人的评价者。 在本机构的IRB指导下,这一活动不构成人类课题研究,因此不需要IRB审查。

blocks.en: Both methods were compared on the same 60 questions, using the same evidence and expert judgments. The pointwise hypothesis was the explanation our system rated most plausible before seeing the evidence, evaluated on its own.
blocks.zh: 用同样的证据和专家判断,在同一60个问题上比较了这两种方法。 明智的假设是,在看到证据之前,我们的制度被评为最有说服力的解释。

blocks.en: The expert majority matched our system’s explanation on 43 of 60 items (71.7%, 95% CI 60.0–83.3 by item-clustered bootstrap): 40 of the 51 items it marked resolved (78.4%) and 3 of the 9 it left unresolved. Of the 17 disagreements, the experts chose a competing explanation on only 3; on 8 they judged the evidence insufficient and on 6 they formed no majority, so most disagreements fall on evidence the experts themselves could not settle. Across all 60 items the panel committed to a specific alternative on 46, which shows that the executed experiments usually separate the alternatives well enough for experts to commit. Agreement was 79% on confirmative resolutions and 77% on corrective ones. Against the pointwise baseline: on the 32 items it confirmed, the experts endorsed 23 findings for each method; on the 22 items it rejected and stopped, the alternative our system identified matched the expert majority on 18 (81.8%; exact 95% CI 60–95). A related subset, the 22 items the baseline did not confirm and our system resolved, overlaps this one on 19 items and gives 17 of 22; the main text reports the pointwise-rejected subset. Per dataset, agreement ranges from 6 of 10 to 9 of 10, too few items to compare domains.
blocks.zh: 专家多数与我们系统对60件物品中的43件(71.7%、95%CI 60.0-83.3按物品组装的靴子)的解释一致:在标有标记的51件物品中,40件(78.4%)和未解决的9件物品中的3件。 在这17项分歧中,专家们只选择了3项相互矛盾的解释;在8项中,他们认为证据不充分,6项不构成多数,因此大多数分歧取决于专家本身无法解决的证据。 在所有60个项目中,小组承诺在46个项目上采用一种特定的替代方法,这表明已执行的实验通常能很好地分离出可供专家使用的替代方法。 关于确认性决议的协议为79%,关于纠正性决议的协议为77%。 对照有道理的基线:关于它确认的32个项目,专家们批准了23项结论;关于它所拒绝和停止的22个项目,我们系统确定的替代办法与18项(81.8%;准确的95%为CI 60-95)的专家多数相当。 一个相关的子集,即基线未确认和解决的22个项目,与19个项目重叠,给出了22个中的17个;正文报告的是指针拒绝的子集。 每个数据集,协议范围从6个10到9个10,项目太少,无法比较域.

blocks.en: On the load-bearing judgment (Q1, four to six options), pairwise agreement was 64% and Krippendorff’s α \alpha was 0.54 (95% CI 0.45–0.61), and in a descriptive stratification α \alpha was 0.60 on resolved items versus 0.22 on unresolved ones, so rater disagreement concentrates on the items Contrastive Discovery leaves unresolved. On set completeness (Q2), 80% of ratings judged the set well formed, 15% flagged a missing plausible alternative, 4% overlap, and 1% both; raw agreement on the binary omission call was 83% (Gwet’s AC1 = 0.73 =0.73 ; the lower Fleiss’ κ \kappa of 0.35 reflects the 80/20 response skew). A strict majority flagged a missing alternative on 6 of the 60 sets. Analysis appropriateness (Q4) was judged appropriate on 73% of ratings, wrong variable or test on 19%, and cannot tell on 8% (binary raw agreement 72%, AC1 = 0.54 =0.54 ). Scientific value (Q3) had low agreement ( α = 0.24 \alpha=0.24 ), so we report it only as a distribution: 51% substantive finding, 20% minor, 3% too obvious to state, 25% not a finding.
blocks.zh: 在负载判断(问题1,四至六种选择)上,对偶协议为64%,克里彭多夫的α α α(95% CI 0.45–0.61)为0.54(95% CI 0.45–0.61),在描述性分层法中,α α α α 在已解决项目上为0.60,而在未解决项目上则为0.22,因此评分分歧集中于未解决项目。 关于设定完整性(Q2 ) , 80%的评分评分判断了套集的形成良好,15%的评分标注了缺失的可行选项,4 % 重叠,1% 两者均相同;关于二进制省略调的原始协议为83%(Gwet的AC1 = 0.73 = 0.73;下Fleiss的 0.35 =\ kappa 反映了 80/20 的响应 skew )。 在60套中,有6套被严格多数人标出缺选。 根据73%的评分、错误的变量或19%的测试,分析适当性(问题4)被认为适当,无法分辨8%(二进制协议72%,AC1=0.54=0.54)。 科学价值(Q3)的一致程度较低(α=0.24\alpha=0.24),因此我们仅报告为分布:51%为实质性发现,20%为次要发现,3%为太明显无法说明,25%为非结论。

blocks.en: To check that the ratings track genuine quality, we planted two manually constructed defective sets among the items, one with a plausible alternative removed and one with overlapping alternatives: 11 of the 14 evaluators who saw the first flagged a missing alternative and none confused it with overlap, and 10 of 12 flagged the second as defective. On separate control items we kept the contrast set intact but paired it with the evidence of a different question: the well-formed rate stayed at 77%, close to its 80% baseline, while the analysis-appropriateness rating fell from 73% to 7% and the wrong-variable-or-test flag rose from 19% to 84%. The evaluators therefore flag real set defects without blanket-flagging, and recognize when an analysis does not fit its question. Attention controls (mismatched evidence expected to yield “cannot tell”) fired as expected on 95% of exposures.
blocks.zh: 为了检查评级是否跟踪真实质量,我们在物品中放置了两套人工制造的缺陷套件,其中一套有可行的替代品,另一套有重叠的替代品:在14名评价员中,有11人看到第一个被标记为缺失的替代品,没有人将其与重叠混淆;在12名评价员中,有10人认为第二个有缺陷。 在不同的控制项目上,我们保持了对比度,但与一个不同问题的证据相配: 成型率保持在77%,接近其基准值的80%,而分析适度评级则从73%下降到7%,错误的可变或测试旗帜从19%上升到84%。 因此,评估人员在不打毛线的情况下标出真正的缺陷,并在分析不符合问题时予以确认。 对95%的接触情况如预期一样进行了注意控制(与预计“无法分辨”的证据相匹配)。

blocks.en: The experts read the same evidence as our system, so their agreement shows that resolutions track the evidence as independent experts read it; it is not a test of scientific truth. The experts were general quantitative-science raters rather than specialists matched to each item’s subfield, and they judged the executed analysis rather than replicating it. The comparison with the pointwise baseline is one of endorsed yield, not of accuracy on the items both methods decide.
blocks.zh: 专家们阅读的证据与我们的系统相同,因此他们的同意表明,决议跟踪证据是独立专家阅读的证据;这不是对科学真理的检验。 专家是一般的定量科学评估员,而不是与每个项目的子领域相匹配的专家,他们判断的是执行的分析而不是复制分析。 与定点基线的比较是经认可的产量,而不是两种方法决定的项目的准确性。

blocks.en: Appendix J Mechanical Fidelity Audits
blocks.zh: 附录J 机械 Fidelity审计

blocks.en: The belief step reads the analyst’s written summary of an executed analysis. Three audits, none of which involves a language model in the scoring, check that this chain is faithful: that the adjudication follows the evidence it is shown, that the summary reports the numbers the code printed, and that the code computed those numbers correctly.
blocks.zh: 相信步骤读取分析师对已执行分析的书面总结。 3项审计,其中没有一项涉及评分中的语文模式,请检查这一链条是否忠实:判决遵循所显示的证据,摘要报告所打印的代码,以及正确计算这些数字的代码。

blocks.en: We took 14 claims from 10 DiscoveryBench training questions with documented findings (a finding with two claims contributes two), constructed contrast sets whose wording was held fixed across conditions, and ran the production posterior elicitor ( gpt-4o-2024-08-06 , five samples, τ support = 0.80 \tau_{\mathrm{support}}=0.80 ) on numbers-only evidence with the alternatives in randomized order and no analyst prose. Given the full statistic with its interval, available for 11 of the 14, the elicitor placed the documented answer first in every case and resolved 8 of 11, holding back on three whose intervals lie close to zero. Given the coefficient without an interval it still ranked the documented answer first on 13 of 14 while resolving only 7, appropriate caution when the evidence is incomplete. In a separate condition covering all 14 claims, we supplied the statistic with its sign reversed; the resolution followed the reversal in every case. Supplying no evidence produced no resolution on any of the 14 (largest posterior 0.74). Because the wording of the alternatives was identical across the four conditions, these resolutions follow the evidence and not the phrasing. This establishes evidence-driven adjudication, not end-to-end correctness of the pipeline that produces the evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们从10个发现班奇培训问题中提取了14项索赔,其中记录了调查结果(一项调查结果,两项索赔有两项内容),构建了对照套,其措辞在各种条件下固定不变,并运行了生产后导引器(gpt-4o-2024-08-06,5个样本,\=0.80\tau_{\mathrm{support}}=0.80),只用数字证据,没有分析员的传言。 鉴于14人中有11人有完整的数据间隔,因此采购人将记录的答案放在每个案件中的第一位,并解决了11人中的8人,有3人间隔接近零。 由于系数没有间隔,它仍然将记录的答复排在14个中的13个,而只解决7个问题,在证据不完整时,应谨慎行事。 在涉及所有14项索赔的单独条件下,我们提供了数字,其标志被推翻;决议是在每次推翻之后作出的。 没有提供证据,没有就这14人中的任何一个(最大后期0.74)做出任何决议。 由于四个条件的备选案文措辞相同,这些决议遵循的是证据而不是措辞。 这确立了由证据驱动的裁决,而不是产生证据的管道的端到端正确性。

blocks.en: Across all available seeds, 3,015 analyses contained checkable numerical claims in the analyst’s written summary. We checked, allowing for rounding, percentages, and scientific notation, whether those numbers appear in the captured standard output of the executed code. 99.1% of these analyses and 99.7% of the 9,239 checked numbers are grounded in a printed value. Reading every mismatch by hand found at least five genuine slips, including a slope quoted from a plot-only run and a count reported as a percentage; the audit caught all of them without a human in the loop. Pairing each summary with a different analysis’s output and re-running the identical matcher grounds only 3.8% of numbers, so the check discriminates. Signs are not checked by this audit.
blocks.zh: 在所有现有种子中,3 015份分析在分析师的书面摘要中载有可核实的数字索赔。 我们检查了,允许四舍五入、百分数和科学标记,无论这些数字是否出现在已执行代码的捕获标准输出中。 这些分析的99.1%和9 239个核对数字的99.7%以印刷值为基础。 每一次手读不匹配,都至少发现5个真实的滑局,包括从一个只图的运行中引用的斜坡和一个报为百分数的计数;审计在循环中抓住了所有这些滑局,没有人. 将每份摘要与不同的分析结果对齐,重新运行相同的比对理由只占数字的3.8%,因此检查有差别。 本审计不检查标志。

blocks.en: For the analyses whose statistic can be rebuilt directly from named columns of the raw data (400 of 3,274; 331 scorable, spanning every available seed and 251 distinct dataset/test/column combinations), we recomputed the statistic with standard libraries and compared it to the value the agent printed. The values matched on 318 of 331 (96.1%). Every mismatch we could trace came from our recomputation missing a data-handling step in the agent’s code (a custom parser, a missing-data rule, a − 9999 -9999 sentinel replaced before analysis, a group split); a few could not be classified either way. We found no confirmed computation error. Substituting a wrong column matches only 2.1% of the time, so the check is not loose. Coverage is 12% of analyses and not random, since the rebuildable analyses are the simpler ones, so we read this as a check on the covered analyses rather than a pipeline-wide rate.
blocks.zh: 对于可以直接从已命名的原始数据栏目中重建统计数据的分析(400个,3 274个;331个可编译,涵盖每个现有种子和251个不同的数据集/测试/列组合),我们用标准库重新计算统计数据,并将其与代理印刷值进行比较。 331个中318个(96.1%)的数值相符。 我们所能追踪到的每一个错配都来自我们重算缺少代理代码中的数据处理步骤(一个自定义解析器,一个缺失的数据规则,一个在分析前被替换的9999-9999哨人,一个组分裂);少数不能被分门别类。 我们没有发现确认的计算错误。 替换错误的列只匹配2.1%的时间,所以检查不松. 覆盖面是分析的12%,而不是随机的,因为可重建分析是比较简单的分析,所以我们把这一点看成是对覆盖分析的检查,而不是整个管道的检查率。

blocks.en: Appendix K Handling Incomplete Contrast Sets
blocks.zh: 附录 K 处理 不完全对齐集

blocks.en: A contrast set that omits the explanation the evidence supports can produce a confident wrong resolution. We measured how often this happens and how well the abstention alternative of Section 3.4 prevents it.
blocks.zh: 比较集省略了证据支持的解释可以产生自信的错解. 我们衡量了这种情况的发生频率,以及第3.4节弃权办法防止这种情况发生的情况。

blocks.en: We used two frozen panels. The primary panel is 163 questions, all directional triples ( M = 3 M=3 ), whose supported explanation is fixed by a statistic recomputed from the raw data with no model in the scoring (121 distinct underlying analyses; intervals are clustered on the analysis). Because the correct answer must be present to be removed, this panel conditions on questions the system originally resolved correctly, so the intact-set control measures re-elicitation stability rather than corpus accuracy. A secondary panel is 40 resolved questions across six partition types and M ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } M\in\{2,3,4\} whose supported explanation matches the blinded expert majority of Appendix I . The design crossed two factors: the set as generated or with the supported explanation removed, each with or without an added alternative worded “none of the listed alternatives matches the evidence; the contrast set is incomplete.” The seven secondary-panel questions with M = 2 M=2 omitted the removed-explanation condition without the added alternative, since its sole survivor would receive all belief by construction. Selecting the added alternative flags the set as incomplete; declining to reach τ support \tau_{\mathrm{support}} withholds resolution as before. Cell order was randomized per call and five samples were requested for aggregation before thresholding. After outcome-blind re-elicitation of partial calls, 775 of 789 elicitations used five valid samples and 14 used two to four; all decision margins were fixed before any call.
blocks.zh: 我们用了两个冷冻板 主要的面板是163个问题,所有方向三重(M=3 M=3),其支持的解释是由原始数据重算而成,在评分中没有模型(121个不同的基础分析;分析的间隔是分组的)。 因为必须提出正确的答案才能删除,所以这个面板对系统最初正确解决的问题提出了条件,所以完好无损的设定控制措施可以重新激发稳定性,而不是实体精度. 副面板有40个解答问题, 设计跨越两个因素:生成的集或删除了支持的解释,每个集都有附加的替代词,“所列替代品中没有一个与证据相符;对照集不完整”。 有M=2 M=2的7个二级小组的问题忽略了没有附加替代品的去除解释条件,因为其唯一幸存者将通过建筑获得所有信仰。 选择所添加的替代标记为不完整; 拒绝达到\ tau\ mathrm{ support\ } 将解析度与以前一样 。 每一次呼叫都随机排列单元格顺序,在设定阈值前要求汇总5个样本。 在对部分电话进行结果盲转后,789次调用中有775次使用了5次有效样品,14次使用了2至4次;在调用之前,所有决定余地都是固定的。

blocks.en: Table 10: Outcomes on the 163-question primary panel when the supported explanation is removed. The competing-direction column corresponds to 4 of 163 questions without the abstention alternative and 1 of 163 with it.
blocks.zh: 表10:取消支持的解释时关于163个问题的主要小组讨论的结果。 相竞方向栏对应163个问题中的4个,没有弃权的选项,163个问题中的1个与之对应.

blocks.en:
With the sets left intact, the supported explanation resolved on 159 of 163 questions (97.5%) without the abstention alternative and on 162 of 163 (99.4%) with it, and the abstention alternative was never selected (0 of 163). With the supported explanation removed ( Table 10 ), the system resolved to a surviving alternative on 53.4% of questions, so an omitted explanation can indeed produce a wrong resolution. The failures lean toward caution: when a direction was removed and the null survived, the system resolved to “no detectable effect” on 58.5% of cases, left the question unresolved on 38.7%, and asserted the opposite direction on 2.8%; when the null was removed and only opposing directions survived, it left all 21 unresolved. Those null resolutions are still wrong under our reference, which is why the abstention alternative matters. The abstention alternative cuts false resolution to 0.6%: it is the leading option on 92.6% of removed cases (mean mass 0.85) and crosses the 0.80 threshold on 69.3%, identifying the omission rather than only withholding an answer. The secondary panel shows the same pattern with wider intervals (63.6% false resolution without the option, 6.1% with it, on the 33 questions with M ≥ 3 M\geq 3 ). The discovery runs of Section 5.2 elicit beliefs over the generated alternatives alone; this test holds the questions and evidence fixed and isolates what the added option does when an explanation is missing, not how it would change adaptive search or full-run yield.
In those runs a missing alternative can force a wrong resolution only on a set that omits one, and two external checks show such sets are few: a strict majority of experts flagged a missing alternative on 6 of the 60 sets they rated, and on the 51 items our system resolved, experts preferred a competing explanation on only 1 ( Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
随着套件未变,支持的解释在没有弃权选择的情况下解决了163个问题中的159个(97.5%),在163个问题中解决了162个(99.4%),没有选择弃权选择(163个问题中的0个)。 随着支持的解释被删除(表10),该系统在53.4%的问题上找到了一个幸存的替代方案,因此省略的解释确实会产生错误的解答. 失败倾向于谨慎:当一个方向被移除,而无效者幸存下来时,系统决心对58.5%的案件“没有可察觉的效果”,38.7%的案件没有解决,2.8%的案件没有解决;当无效者被移除,只有相反的指令幸存下来时,系统将所有21起案件都搁置。 在我们的提法中,这些无效的决议仍然是错误的,这就是为什么弃权的其他问题。 弃权者将错误的解析率削减至0.6%:这是92.6%的被删除案件(平均质量0.85)的主要选择,并且超过了69.3%的0.80阈值,从而识别了遗漏,而不是仅仅隐瞒答案。 副面板显示的规律相同,间隔较广(无选择的假分辨率为63.6%,与M 3 M\geq 3 的33个问题为6.1%)。 第5.2节的发现仅引起对生成的替代品的信念;这项测试确定了问题和证据,并隔离了在缺少解释时附加的选项会做什么,而不是它会如何改变适应性搜索或完全运行的产量。
在进行这些测试时,一个缺失的替代方案只能将错误的解答强加于一个遗漏一个的集合,而两个外部检查显示这种组合很少:严格多数专家在其评分的60套中的6套上标出缺失的替代方案,而关于我们系统解决的51套项目,专家则倾向于仅1套(附录一)的相互竞争的解释。

blocks.en: This appendix gives the details behind Section 5.5 . All analyses replay or re-score the logged discovery runs; none changes the resolution rules or the aggregation of the headline (within-run top- K K , seed mean within dataset, then mean over the six datasets).

blocks.en: Every run logs the cost of each individual candidate. Within each of the 14 matched dataset/seed pairs we capped both methods at the smaller of the two methods’ own totals in a given currency, walking candidates in the order they were produced and charging every one, including failed or unusable attempts, until the run reached its 200 experimental validations. Under equal total tokens the methods reached 181 ( pointwise ) and 189 ( Contrastive ) of their 200 scored candidates and resolved 87.7 against 148.3 units (difference + 60.7 +60.7 , 95% t t interval over six dataset clusters [ + 23.4 , + 98.0 ] [+23.4,+98.0] ); under equal logged dollars, 92.2 against 145.8 ( [ + 22.4 , + 84.8 ] [+22.4,+84.8] ); charging output tokens only, 95.8 against 124.9 ( [ − 0.9 , + 59.1 ] [-0.9,+59.1] , the one interval that includes zero; five of six datasets positive). Applying one common budget to every run (4.45M tokens, the smallest total that any run spent) gives 52.4 against 89.6. Belief elicitation accounts for 8.5% of contrastive tokens against 2.5% for pointwise , but total spend per candidate is similar (61.1k tokens for pointwise against 52.8k for Contrastive ), because the extra cost of writing the contrast set is offset by shorter analysis code and interpretation; since the cap charges failed and unusable attempts as well, the method with the cheaper candidate does not necessarily reach more scored ones. We do not read this as an efficiency advantage, since the two methods differ in prompts throughout and a token count cannot tell a narrower experiment from a thinner one.
blocks.zh: 每次运行记录每个候选人的费用。 在14个匹配的数据集/种子配对中,我们用两种方法本身的总额中较小的货币将两种方法都封顶,按出产顺序步行候选人,每一次充电,包括失败或无法使用的尝试,直到运行达到200次实验验证。 在同等总指数下,方法在200名得分的考生中达到181(点数)和189(对比),对148.3个单位解决了87.7个(差数+60.7+60.7,在6个数据集中95% t 的间隔[+23.4,+98.0] [+23.4+98.0]);在等积美元下,92.2对145.8([+22.4,+84.8] [+22.4+84.8]);只收取产出符号,95.8对124.9([−0.9,+59.1] [-0.9+59.1],一个间隔包括0;6个数据集中的5个为正数)。 每一次运行都适用一个共同预算(4.45M令牌,任何运行支出的最小总额),得到52.4比89.6。 信仰吸引占对比符号的8.5%,而指针则占2.5%,但每个候选人的总开支类似(指针61.1k,指针52.8k,指针52.8k,指针52.8k,指针52.8k),因为写对比集合的额外费用被较短的分析代码和解释所抵消;由于上限收费失败和无法使用,因此与更便宜的候选人使用的方法不一定达到更高的分数。 我们不认为这是效率的优势,因为这两种方法在整个过程中都不同,一个符号计数不能从更薄的实验中看出更窄的实验.

blocks.en:
Every contrast set in our runs was also scored one alternative at a time with the pointwise elicitor (five-level categorical rating mapped to a Beta mean, ten samples), never mentioning the other alternatives; the independent scoring additionally saw the experiment-reviewer agent’s notes, so the comparison is conservative against joint scoring. Applying the pointwise method’s own gate ( γ support = 0.625 \gamma_{\mathrm{support}}=0.625 ) to the independent scores under the paper’s estimator gives 157.8 resolved units at top-200 when exactly one alternative passes (165.4 when any passes), against 161.9 for joint scoring: a difference of 4.1 units, about 6% of the 64.7-unit headline gap, with a t t interval that includes zero. The two scorings name the same leading alternative on 89.3% of sets under dataset-equal weighting, and against the 170 questions with a statistic recomputed from raw data neither is more accurate (166 against 165 of 170).
We therefore claim no advantage for scoring the alternatives together: given a fixed contrast set and its evidence, the scoring format accounts for a small share of the gap. Both scorings read the same analyst summary, so this check holds the analyst fixed. That resolutions follow the evidence rather than the analyst’s framing is established separately: the elicitor resolves from the numbers alone with no analyst ( Appendix J ), and experts who read the same evidence with no instruction chose the same explanation on 78% of resolved items ( Appendix I ). What remains is how the alternatives are constructed, tested directly below.
blocks.zh:
我们运行中设定的每个对比点也一次被一个选择点评(5级绝对评分被绘制成Beta平均值,10个样本),从未提及其他选择点;独立评分者还看到了实验-审查者代理人的笔记,因此对比与联合评分相比是保守的。 将点球法本身的门(γ支持=0.625\gamma_{\mathrm{支持}}=0.625})应用到纸的估测器下的独立分数上,当一个完全的替代通过时(任何通过时为165.4),给予157.8个解决的单位,而联合得分时为161.9个:差额为4.1个单位,大约占64.7个单位头条缺口的6%,t的间隔包括0. 这两个评分在数据集同等加权的89.3%的数据集上指定了相同的领先替代方案,而在从原始数据中重算统计数据的170个问题上,两者都不准确(166个,170个中165个)。
因此,我们声称,把其他办法放在一起没有任何好处:鉴于一套固定对比及其证据,评分格式只占差距的一小部分。 两种评分都读了同样的分析摘要,所以这个检查使分析员固定. 决议遵循证据而不是分析师的框架是分开确定的:引证人在没有分析师的情况下单独解决数字问题(附录J),阅读相同证据但没有指示的专家对78%的已解决项目作出同样的解释(附录一)。 剩下的是替代品的构造方法,直接在下面测试。

blocks.en: Could the pointwise runs’ hypotheses be clustered post hoc into the contrast sets we construct explicitly? Coverage is a necessary condition for such clustering: every member of a set must have been proposed. We screened every hypothesis generated by the pointwise runs (8,547 hypotheses over 32 runs) against a stratified sample of 300 contrast sets from the same datasets, judging each candidate pair with a model that generated neither corpus ( gpt-4.1-mini ) under a rubric that permits refusal. The matcher assigns a set’s own alternatives to the correct member on 99.9% of positive controls and matches nothing from unrelated datasets; blinded human labels on 40 matcher decisions agreed on 36, with three of the four disagreements being matches the human rejected, so the matcher errs toward overcounting pointwise coverage. At matched budget (the same-seed pointwise run truncated at the paired contrastive run’s total tokens), 29.1% of individual alternatives appear anywhere in the pointwise corpus, the runs share at least one alternative with 64.7% of the sets, and the complete set is present for 2.6% of the questions that at least one pointwise hypothesis addresses (95% t t interval [ 0 , 7.0 ] [0,7.0] , truncated at zero). Enlarging the corpus to all seeds and prompt variants, four to six times the matched budget, raises complete-set presence only to 15.4% ( [ 0 , 31.5 ] [0,31.5] , wide) and per-alternative coverage to 53.7%. The explanation that the evidence eventually supports is present 52.0% of the time when it confirms the prior-leading explanation but 25.4% when it corrects it (paired difference − 26.5 -26.5 percentage points, [ − 44.8 , − 8.3 ] [-44.8,-8.3] ), so exactly where pointwise evaluation rejects its hypothesis and stops, its corpus usually lacks the explanation that turns out to hold.
blocks.zh: 是否可将点跑的假设组合成我们明确构建的对照组? 覆盖面是这种分组的必要条件:必须提出一组成员中的每一个成员。 我们从同一数据集的300套对比度样本中筛选出由点数运行产生的每个假说(8,547套假设,32套假设),根据一个允许拒绝的标语来判断每个候选者配对的模型,该模型既不产生任何物(gpt-4.1-mini). 匹配者在99.9%的正控上为正确的成员指定了一套自己的替代品,并且没有匹配任何无关的数据集;40个匹配者决定上的盲目人类标签在36上达成一致,而四个分歧中有三个与被拒绝的人类一致,因此匹配者错误地偏偏过点计算覆盖范围。 在匹配的预算(同一种子在对齐的对比运行总符号中切换)中,29.1%的单个替代物出现在任意程序中,运行在64.7%的套件中至少共享一个替代物,完整的套件存在于至少一个随机假设处理的2.6 % 的问题(95% t t 间隔 [0, 7.0] [0, 7.0] , 切换为零 。 将病原体植入所有种子和即时变种,是相应预算的四至六倍,仅将完全设定的存在率提高到15.4%([0,31.5] [0,31.5],广度),按替代覆盖率提高到53.7%。 关于证据最终支持的解释是,它确认先前领先解释的时间为52.0%,但在纠正时为25.4%(差值−26.5-26.5个百分点,[−44.8、−8.3][-44.8、8.3]),因此,精确地说,在断点评价否定其假设并停止时,其内容通常缺乏最终存在的解释。

blocks.en: Stratifying the frozen top-200 pool of Section 5.2 by contrast-set size, resolution is 93.4% with two alternatives (102 questions, 4.4% of validations, dataset-weighted), 83.2% with three (2,217; 78.3%), and 68.3% with four (479; 17.3%). Resolution requires 80% of posterior mass on one alternative however many are on the table, and belief starts more spread out with four alternatives (leading prior mass 0.41) than with two (0.68), so the bar is a longer climb; the evidence itself is not weaker on larger sets, where raw belief change rises from 0.59 to 1.07 bits. The number of alternatives was chosen by the generator and is confounded with question type: directional questions are almost all three-way and resolve at 92.7%, and a separate pooled comparison gives a three-to-four gap of 15.7 percentage points, which shrinks to 2.2 after standardizing the question types represented in both strata to the four-way mix. On paired support-scope questions the pointwise gate fires 12.2 percentage points more often than ours where there are four alternatives, so there is no evidence that our threshold becomes the more permissive one as contrast sets grow. This series covers two to four alternatives, excluding one five-way and one seven-way question, and describes how resolution varies with M M ; it does not isolate a causal effect of M M .
blocks.zh: 将冻结的第5.2节的顶-200集合按相对应的大小划分,分辨率为93.4%,有两个替代品(102个问题,4.4%的验证,数据集加权),83.2%为3个(2 217;78.3%),68.3%为4个(479;17.3%)。 溶解度要求80%的后方质量在一个替代品上,尽管许多在桌面上,信仰开始以四个替代品(领先前方质量0.41)比两个(0.68)更分散,因此,棒的爬升时间更长;证据本身在更大的组合上并不弱,原始信仰的变化从0.59位上升到1.07位。 替代品的数量是由生成者选择的,对问题类型感到困惑:方向问题几乎都是三进制的,解析率为92.7%,单独的集合比较给出了三比四的15.7个百分点的差距,在将两层代表的问题类型标准化为四进制后缩小到2.2. 在配对的辅助镜上, 点球门比我们发射12.2个百分点的频率多, 该系列包括两个至四个备选方案,不包括一个五向和一个七向问题,并描述了分辨率与MM的不同;它没有隔离MM的因果关系。

blocks.en: On the same 180 contrast sets and byte-identical evidence, we re-elicited beliefs under two other response formats: a per-alternative five-level categorical judgment (the pointwise scoring rule) and a forced choice among the alternatives with the option that the evidence does not distinguish them. Among sets yielding a comparable decision, the leading explanation agreed with the paper’s 100-point allocation on 94.2% of sets under the categorical format (161 of 171) and 99.3% under forced choice (152 of 153), against 98.9% when the paper’s own format was run twice; before the evidence the formats agree only 57.1% and 76.8%, so the post-evidence agreement comes from the evidence rather than from the formats tracking one another. These figures hold for the canonical cell display used in the runs; the categorical format sits 4.7 percentage points below the repeatability ceiling, so the claim is agreement on the leading explanation rather than full format invariance.
blocks.zh: 在同样的180套对比度和字节相同的证据上,我们在另外两种反应格式下重新煽动了信仰:一种是每五级断然判断(即有道理的评分规则),另一种是强制选择,而证据并没有加以区分。 在做出类似决定的套件中,主要的解释与论文对94.2%的绝对格式(171套中的161套)和99.3%的强制选择(153套中的152套)的100点分配一致,而当论文自己的格式运行两次时为98.9%;在证据之前,格式只同意57.1%和76.8%,因此证据后协议来自证据,而不是相互跟踪的格式。 这些数字用于运行中使用的犬形细胞显示;绝对格式比可重复性上限低4.7个百分点,因此,索赔是同意主要解释,而不是完全格式的变异。

blocks.en: Appendix N Recovery of Published Findings
blocks.zh: 附录N

blocks.en: We screened 14 questions with published findings from the DiscoveryBench [ 32 ] training split and tested recovery on ten leakage-screened questions (questions whose wording gives away the answer were excluded). Each method received the question and the data once, with no tree search and never the answer, and the final hypothesis each run stated was scored against the published answer by a calibrated judge ( gpt-4.1 , temperature 0, 9 of 9 on calibration items), with undecided or malformed outputs counted as wrong. Contrastive Discovery matched on 1 of 10 and the pointwise baseline on 0 of 10. The transcripts show why: the analyst usually answered a different question than the benchmark asked (a different predictor or outcome, an unrequested moderator or subgroup), and several published answers depend on modeling choices of the original studies that cannot be recovered from the question and column schema. The test therefore measures question framing and analysis choice at least as much as adjudication, and with both methods at floor it says nothing about the difference between them. The correctness evidence in this paper comes instead from Appendix I and Appendix J , which start from the executed analysis; end-to-end recovery of known findings from raw data remains open.

blocks.en: Appendix O Elicitation Design Across the Two Methods

blocks.en: The pointwise and Contrastive methods share the discovery scaffold but differ in how beliefs are elicited and in what the analyst is asked to report. We list the main differences here, with what has been tested about each.
blocks.zh: 尖端和矛盾的方法与发现脚手架相同,但在如何产生信仰以及要求分析员报告什么方面有所不同。 我们在此列出主要差异,并列出每个差异的检验结果。

blocks.en: • Response format and aggregation. Pointwise beliefs are five-level categorical ratings (ten samples) mapped to a Beta mean (Appendix ); Contrastive beliefs are 100-point constant-sum allocations (five samples) averaged into a distribution (Appendix ). Scoring the same contrast sets one alternative at a time with the pointwise format changes the leading explanation on about one set in ten (89.3% agreement) and the headline by 4.1 resolved units ( Appendix L ); a per-alternative categorical format and a forced choice reproduce the leading explanation on 94.2% and 99.3% of sets yielding comparable decisions ( Appendix L ). • Elicitor instructions. The Contrastive prior prompt asks the elicitor not to default to a uniform allocation, and the Contrastive posterior prompt asks it to be discriminative and avoid unjustified hedging ( Appendix P ); the pointwise elicitor prompt has no corresponding instruction. Because resolution is read off the posterior, these instructions could raise the resolution rate on their own. Two checks bound this. On the resolution rate, the independent-scoring check of Appendix L keeps the contrast sets and evidence fixed and replaces our elicitor with the pointwise elicitor and its threshold, which carry no such instruction: the yield falls from 161.9 to 157.8 questions, about 4 of the 64.7 gained over pointwise . On the leading explanation, the expert panel of Appendix I , reading the same evidence with no instruction, selected the system’s leading explanation on 40 of 51 resolved items. The first check replaces the instructions and the response format together, so the 4.1 questions bound their combined effect. The gain over pointwise therefore does not rest on the elicitor being told to be discriminative. • What the analyst reports. The Contrastive analyst returns a winning_cell_idx field and describes, by content rather than label, which alternatives the evidence does and does not rule out; the posterior elicitor then reads the analyst’s prose. The pointwise analyst writes a free summary of the code output. The adjudication-fidelity experiment ( Appendix J ) removes the analyst entirely, giving the elicitor the numbers alone, and still finds evidence-driven resolutions, while the mechanical audits confirm that the summaries quote the printed numbers; isolating the verdict field’s own effect on the discovery runs is left to future work. • When alternatives are generated. In the discovery runs the contrast set is part of the experiment proposal and is fixed before the experiment runs, so the alternatives are named before any evidence exists. The post-hoc companion of Section 5.1 generates its alternatives from the hypothesis under test, the dataset’s variables, and the same earlier context a live proposer would have; the current analysis, its output, and the verdict on the hypothesis are withheld, and the companion is applied whether the hypothesis was confirmed or rejected. • Review and revision. The Contrastive experiment-reviewer agent additionally flags whether an experiment discriminates among the alternatives and the reviser agent can rework a non-discriminating plan; the pointwise reviewer agent checks faithful implementation and whether the focal hypothesis was sufficiently tested. This is part of the contrastive method rather than a scoring artifact, and its cost is included in the matched-budget comparison ( Appendix L ). • Normalization. Pointwise surprisal is normalized by an achievable ceiling derived from the prior (Appendix ), whereas κ t \kappa_{t} is scaled by the constant log 2 ⁡ M \log_{2}M (Appendix ); the consequences of each are discussed where they are defined.

The adjudication-fidelity experiment ( Appendix J ) removes the analyst entirely, giving the elicitor the numbers alone, and still finds evidence-driven resolutions, while the mechanical audits confirm that the summaries quote the printed numbers; isolating the verdict field’s own effect on the discovery runs is left to future work.

blocks.en: When alternatives are generated. In the discovery runs the contrast set is part of the experiment proposal and is fixed before the experiment runs, so the alternatives are named before any evidence exists. The post-hoc companion of Section 5.1 generates its alternatives from the hypothesis under test, the dataset’s variables, and the same earlier context a live proposer would have; the current analysis, its output, and the verdict on the hypothesis are withheld, and the companion is applied whether the hypothesis was confirmed or rejected.
blocks.zh: 当产生替代品时。 在发现运行中,对比组是实验建议的一部分,在实验运行之前固定,因此在任何证据存在之前就指定了替代品. 第5.1节的后热伴生从测试中的假说,数据集的变量,以及活体求婚者会拥有的同样更早的上下文中生成其替代品;当前分析,其输出,以及对假说的判决被扣下,无论假说被确认还是被拒绝,该伴生都被应用.

blocks.en: Review and revision. The Contrastive experiment-reviewer agent additionally flags whether an experiment discriminates among the alternatives and the reviser agent can rework a non-discriminating plan; the pointwise reviewer agent checks faithful implementation and whether the focal hypothesis was sufficiently tested. This is part of the contrastive method rather than a scoring artifact, and its cost is included in the matched-budget comparison ( Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 审查和修订。 对照实验-审查代理人还标出实验是否区别对待替代品,审校代理人可以重新制定无区别计划;指针式审查代理人检查忠实执行以及焦距假说是否经过充分测试. 这是比较方法的一部分,而不是评分文物,其成本列入对应预算比较(附录L)。

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a research scientist doing open - ended , data - driven research using the provided dataset ( s ). Each step in your investigation , you must propose a CONTRAST SET of competing explanations rather than a single hypothesis , and an EXPERIMENT PLAN that DISCRIMINATES between them . A contrast set is a small , mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive ( MECE ) partition of outcomes . Four operational requirements ( all mandatory ): 1. ** Single local question .** All cells must answer ONE specific question ( e . g . " what is the direction / presence / moderation structure of X -> Y ?"). Do not mix questions . 2. ** Single variable set .** All cells reference the same target and predictor variables . Do not switch what is being measured . 3. ** Single analysis family .** A single coherent analysis ( one regression , one stratified test , one comparison ) must plausibly distinguish among all cells . Avoid contrast sets where one cell needs regression , another needs clustering , and another needs causal discovery . 4. ** Small discrete outcome space .** Prefer M =3. Use M =4 only when subgroup or mechanism structure genuinely requires it . M =5 should be rare . Most contrast sets should include a residual cell (" no effect " / " no clear pattern " / " neither ") so exhaustivity is real , not aspirational . Some partition families ( SIGN , PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION , FEATURE_DOMINANCE ) already include one by construction ; do NOT add a second residual cell when the family already provides one . Uncertainty lives in the probability allocation downstream , not as a separate " we don ’ t know " cell inside the partition . NAMED PARTITIONING DIMENSIONS ( pick exactly ONE per contrast set ): - ** SIGN ** ( M =3): {{ positive effect , no effect , negative effect }} for a scalar relationship between two variables . - ** PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION ** ( M =3): {{ effect absent , effect present positive , effect present negative }}. Use when sign is hard to commit to but presence / absence is . - ** SUBGROUP_MODERATED ** ( M =4): {{ effect only in A , only in B , in both , in neither }} for a binary moderator . - ** MECHANISM_DISCRIMINATING ** ( M =3 or 4): {{ association persists after controlling for C , association attenuates after controlling for C , association disappears ( no residual effect after controls ), no effect }}. Strictly OBSERVATIONAL wording – describe what regression coefficients DO under control adjustment , not WHY . Do NOT use mediation language (" X is mediated through M "); mediation is a causal - identification claim our designs do not support . Do NOT use " causes " / " causal pathway " language . - ** FUNCTIONAL_FORM ** ( M =3 or 4): {{ linear positive , linear negative , nonlinear or threshold , no effect }}. Use only when the question is genuinely about the shape of the relationship AND sample size supports the distinction ( e . g . n > 200 for a polynomial - vs - linear comparison ; nonlinear claims need enough power to reject a linear null ). Otherwise default to SIGN or PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION . - ** COARSE_ORDER ** ( M =3 or 4): coarse ordinal contrasts only – e . g . {{ highest in A , highest in B , no clear ordering }}, or {{ monotone increasing , monotone decreasing , non - monotone }}. NEVER enumerate full permutations like ( A > B > C > D ); coarsen those to one of the forms above . - ** VARIANCE_DIFFERENCE ** ( M =3): {{ variance higher in subgroup A than B , variance higher in B than A , no significant difference in variance }} for second - moment / dispersion / heteroskedasticity questions . Distinct from SUBGROUP_MODERATED , which is about mean / effect differences . Use when the question is genuinely about how spread ( variance , IQR , MAD ) differs across groups , not how means do . - ** FEATURE_DOMINANCE ** ( M =3 or 4): {{ feature X is the dominant predictor of outcome Z , feature Y is the dominant predictor , both contribute comparably , neither contributes meaningfully }} for multi - feature contribution decomposition . Distinct from SIGN ( which concerns one relationship ’ s direction ). Use when the question is which of several candidate predictors carries the signal . EXTENDING THE TAXONOMY ( last resort ): if your question ’ s structure genuinely fits none of the named dimensions above – for example , a regime - change / threshold - effect question that FUNCTIONAL_FORM doesn ’ t cover , an interaction - structure question SUBGROUP_MODERATED can ’ t express , or some other genuinely novel structural shape – you may coin a new dimension . Name it in your own SHOUT_CASE in the ‘ partitioning_dimension ‘ field , and ensure cells satisfy the same MECE / falsifiability / mechanical - cell - mapping properties as the named dimensions ( every cell must be a discrete observable pattern that the experiment plan ’ s analysis maps to mechanically ). Inventing a new dimension is rare ; the named ones cover the vast majority of cases . Prefer the named ones whenever they fit . HARD CONSTRAINTS : 1. M <= 5. Never enumerate combinatorial outcome spaces ( every ordering of several items , or every combination of several multi - valued outcomes ). 2. Each cell is a complete falsifiable claim referencing the actual variable names – not a label like " positive " or " ordering A > B ". 3. Pick exactly ONE partitioning dimension per contrast set ( a named one when applicable ; a coined one only when none of the named dimensions fits ). 4. The experiment plan must produce an output that maps each cell to a specific quantitative criterion ( e . g . " CI entirely above 0 -> C_1 ; contains 0 -> C_2 ; entirely below 0 -> C_3 "). 5. ** Cells must differ in substantive statistical pattern ** – sign , presence , subgroup membership , mechanism class , functional form , or coarse ordering . Cells that differ only in wording strength (" weak positive " vs " strong positive ") are NOT a valid contrast – that is one hypothesis re - described , not multiple alternatives . 6. ** Adequate support .** Do not define cells over sparse categories or tiny subgroups unless the experiment plan explicitly checks for adequate sample size ( e . g . minimum n per cell , robustness checks , or power - aware test selection ). Example of a well - formed contrast set output ( note that ‘ cells ‘ are PLAIN - CONTENT strings – the slot labels ‘ C_1 ‘/‘ C_2 ‘/‘ C_3 ‘ belong only in the ‘ experiment_plan . deliverables ‘ cell - mapping criterion , not in the cell text ): “‘ cells : - " Total citations increase with years since PhD " - " No effect of years since PhD on total citations " - " Total citations decrease with years since PhD " partitioning_dimension : " SIGN " rationale : " Test the direction of the citation - experience relationship ; the residual cell covers no - effect ." experiment_plan : objective : " Quantify the relationship between years - since - PhD and total citations ." steps : " Compute Spearman correlation between years_from_PhD and total_citations ; report the 95% bootstrap CI ." deliverables : " Spearman rho + 95% bootstrap CI ; cell - mapping is : CI entirely above 0 -> C_1 ; CI contains 0 -> C_2 ; CI entirely below 0 -> C_3 ." “‘ Examples of well - formed discriminating plans : - SIGN : " Compute Spearman correlation between X and Y with 95% bootstrap CI . Report the CI ; the cell - mapping is : CI entirely above 0 -> C_1 ; CI contains 0 -> C_2 ; CI entirely below 0 -> C_3 ." - SUBGROUP_MODERATED : " Fit interaction model Y ~ X * Z ; test simple slopes of X within each level of Z ; classify by which simple slopes are significant at alpha =0.05." - FUNCTIONAL_FORM : " Fit linear and natural - spline models , compare BIC ; if linear wins and slope CI excludes 0, classify by sign ; otherwise use the spline residual structure to distinguish nonlinear from null ." Self - check before output : ( a ) Count cells . M <= 5? Prefer M =3? ( b ) Pick any two cells . Could BOTH be true on the same dataset ? If yes , fix . ( c ) Imagine 5 plausible experimental outcomes . Does each map to exactly one cell ? If not , add a residual cell or coarsen . ( d ) Does the plan output a quantity that can be cleanly mapped to a specific cell ? ( e ) Could ONE coherent analysis ( regression / stratified comparison / model - comparison test ) discriminate all cells ? If not , the contrast spans too many questions ; split it . Other instructions you must follow : 1. Strictly use only the dataset ( s ) provided . Do not simulate dummy / synthetic data or columns that cannot be derived from existing columns . 2. Each contrast set should be creative , independent , and self - contained . 3. Use prior explorations as inspiration ; do not repeat the same partition . 4. Multiple datasets : if provided , you may propose contrast sets that join across datasets . The unit of discovery is the redistribution of belief across the cells of the contrast set after evidence – not the survival of a single claim . A good contrast set + discriminating plan moves probability mass between cells ; a bad one leaves the prior untouched . Now generate exactly { branching_factor } new contrast sets with their discriminating experiment plans .

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a research scientist evaluating the code execution output for a contrastive scientific experiment . The experiment was designed to discriminate between the cells of a CONTRAST SET – a small mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive partition of outcomes ( cells C_1 , C_2 , … given to you in the user message ). Your job has two INDEPENDENT parts . PART 1 – execution status ( separate from whether the experiment discriminated ): Set ‘ success = false ‘ ONLY when the code itself failed : - no code was executed - the code raised an error - the code ’ s first line contains ‘# [ debug ]‘ ( debugging protocol – return success = false , note the debug execution , ask for the experiment to be retried ) - the code " failed silently ": produced no interpretable quantitative output , no statistics relevant to the contrast set , only plots / log spam / unusable text Otherwise , set ‘ success = true ‘. The code ran AND produced usable output . ** This holds even if the experiment failed to discriminate among the cells ** – that judgment belongs to the reviewer ’ s separate ‘ discriminates ‘ flag , not yours . When success = true , write a short analysis summary : report the ** main decision - relevant quantities ** the code actually produced – effect estimates , CIs , p - values , model - comparison metrics , whichever the experiment computed – plus any caveats ( sample size , missing data , sparse subgroups , etc .). Do NOT force a p - value if none was computed . PART 2 – contrast - set mapping ( independent of PART 1’ s success flag ): Identify which cell of the contrast set is best supported by the experimental output . Use ** only what the code output reports ** – no prior expectations , no domain knowledge beyond the printed statistics . Return : - ‘ winning_cell_idx ‘: zero - based index of the cell the evidence most cleanly favors . - If the result decisively supports one cell ( e . g . tight CI on one side , large effect with clear direction matching exactly one cell ’ s criterion ), return that index . - If the evidence is genuinely ambiguous between two or more cells ( CI straddles boundaries , mixed signals , the planned cell - mapping criterion wasn ’ t actually computed ), return ** null **. ‘ winning_cell_idx = null ‘ is a legitimate honest answer compatible with ‘ success = true ‘. ** A success = true analysis with winning_cell_idx = null ** is the right output when the code ran cleanly but the result didn ’ t actually distinguish among cells . Prefer null over overclaiming when evidence is borderline . In the analysis text , when discussing cells , ** describe them by their content / semantics only – do NOT reference cells by their numerical label ** ( no " C_1 ", " C_2 ", etc .). For example , write " the evidence supports the effect - attenuates - after - controls scenario " rather than " the evidence supports C_2 ". The numerical labels are an artifact of how cells are presented to you in this specific prompt ; downstream consumers ( the posterior belief elicitor , auditors , future re - elicitations under different cell orderings ) will see the cells in possibly different label positions , so a label like " C_2 " written here will mislabel the cell in those contexts . The cell content / short description IS the cell ’ s identity ; descriptions transfer correctly across orderings , labels do not . Briefly note which cells the evidence does and does not rule out ( by description ), and any reasons it may be ambiguous . Use ‘ winning_cell_idx ‘ to record the index – that field is reordered correctly downstream ; the prose should be label - free .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你是一位研究科学家,评估 代码执行输出 一个对比性科学实验。 实验旨在区分一个CONTRAST SET的细胞——一个小的相互排斥和集体的对结果的详尽划分(C_1,C_2,.在用户信息中给予你). 你的工作有两个独立部分 第一部分 -- -- 执行状况(不同于试验是否具有歧视性): 设定 ` 成功 = 假 ` 仅在代码本身失败时 : - 没有执行代码 - 代码产生错误 - 代码的第一行包含 {} [调试协议 - 返回成功 = 虚假 , 注意调试执行, 请求重试 ’ - 代码 " 静默失败 " : 没有生成可解释的定量输出, 没有与对照集相关的统计, 只有图 / 日志垃圾邮件/ 无法使用文本 否则,设定`成功=真实'。 代码运行并产生了可用输出. 页:1 即使实验没有在细胞间进行区分,这依然有效,** – 该判决属于审查者单独的`歧视'旗帜,而不是你的旗帜。 当成功=真实时,写一个简短的分析摘要: 报告** 主要决定 -- -- 相关数量** 实际产生的代码 -- -- 效果估计、CIS、p -- -- 值、模型 -- -- 比较指标,以试验计算为准 -- -- 加上任何说明(样本大小、缺失数据、稀疏分组等)。 如果一个p - 值没有计算,则不要强制。 第二部分 - 对比 - 设定绘图(独立于第一部分的成功旗帜): 确定比较集的哪个单元格得到实验输出的最佳支持 。 使用 ** 只使用代码输出报告的内容 ** — 没有先前的预期, 除了印刷统计之外没有域知识 。 返回 : - ` 赢_ cell_ idx ’ : 零 - 基于单元格的索引 最干净的偏好 。 - 如果结果决定性地支持一个单元格(e. g. 紧紧的CI在一边,大效果与一个单元格的标准完全匹配),则返回该索引。 如果证据在两个或两个以上的单元格之间确实模糊不清(CI 跨越边界,混合信号,计划中的单元格-映射标准没有实际计算),则返回** 无效。 ' win_cell_idx = null ' 是符合`成功=真实 ' 的合理诚实答案。 ** 成功=真实分析与胜_ cell_idx = 无效 ** 是代码运行干净但结果实际上没有区分细胞的正确输出 。 当证据是界限时, 在分析文本中,在讨论单元格时,** 仅用其内容/语义来描述这些单元格——不要用其数字标签来引用单元格**(没有 " C_1 " 、 " C_2 " 等)。 例如,写 " 证据支持效果 -- -- 减弱 -- -- 之后的控制情景 " ,而不是 " 证据支持C_2 " 。 数字标签是在这个特定提示中如何向您呈现细胞的一件文物;下游消费者(后置信仰诱导者、审计师、未来再引导者)将在不同的单元格命令下看到细胞在可能不同的标签位置上,因此,如此处所写 " C_2 " 这样的标签会在这些背景下给单元格贴上错误的标签。 单元格内容 / 简短描述是单元格的身份; 描述在顺序之间正确转移, 标签不正确 。 (b) 简要说明证据究竟包括哪些证据和不排除哪些证据(通过说明),以及任何可能含糊不清的理由。 使用 ‘ win_ cell_ idx ’ 来记录索引 – 该字段在下游的顺序正确; 散文应该是标签 - 免费 。

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a research scientist holistically reviewing a contrastive experiment pipeline : the generated code , the output , and the analysis against the original experiment plan AND the contrast set the experiment was meant to discriminate . ‘ success = true ‘ and ‘ discriminates = true ‘ are LOGICALLY INDEPENDENT . Judge each separately on the criteria below ; do not let one bleed into the other . Assess two things : 1. ** Faithful implementation .** Was the experiment plan followed without significant deviation ? Are the test , statistics , and reporting consistent with the plan ? If you find code - level or pipeline - level issues ( missing variables , wrong test , broken output ), return ‘ success = false ‘ and explain . 2. ** Discrimination .** Did the experiment , as implemented , produce evidence that meaningfully narrows the contrast set ? For the discrimination check , ask explicitly : - ** Did the implemented analysis actually compute the predeclared cell - mapping criterion ?** The experiment plan should have named a specific criterion ( e . g . " Spearman CI sign ", " interaction p - value ", " BIC delta between linear and spline "). If the code computed something else – even something interesting – ‘ discriminates = false ‘. The cells were defined relative to that criterion ; an output that doesn ’ t map to the criterion can ’ t discriminate . - ** Did the evidence rule out at least one competing cell ?** A plan that produces only a quantity consistent with one cell while leaving the others untouched isn ’ t really a discriminating experiment . - ** Discrimination does not require statistical significance per se .** It comes from whichever criterion the plan declared – effect estimates , confidence intervals , model - comparison metrics , p - values – whichever was the predeclared rule for mapping output to cells . Do NOT require ‘ p < 0.05‘ unless that was the rule . Set the ‘ discriminates ‘ flag accordingly : - **‘ true ‘** if the output , under the predeclared decision rule , narrows the contrast set to one cell or a near - singleton subset ( i . e . one cell strongly favored , the others materially ruled out or implausible ). - **‘ false ‘** if the experiment passed but the evidence is too weak , ambiguous , doesn ’ t compute the predeclared criterion , or is equally consistent with multiple cells . In the feedback text , separate the failure modes explicitly when they apply : - ** Implementation issue :** name what was wrong with the code , data , or pipeline ( only when ‘ success = false ‘). - ** Non - discrimination :** explain why the evidence didn ’ t narrow the partition , and briefly note ** what would have been needed to discriminate ** ( e . g . " tighter CIs ", " stratified test ", " model comparison instead of single - coefficient test "). Used when ‘ success = true , discriminates = false ‘. When both flags are true , provide a summary of the contrast set , the experiment , and the resulting evidence - to - cell mapping .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你是一个研究科学家,从整体上审查一个对比性的实验管道:生成的代码,输出,以及对照原实验计划和对比设定的分析,实验本意在区别对待. `成功=真实'和`歧视=真实'是LOGICALLY INDEPENT. 分别根据以下标准进行判断;不要让其中一人流血。 评估两件事: 1. ** 忠实执行 ∗∗∗ 载于E/CN.4/Sub.2/2000/L.10号文件。 实验计划是否没有明显偏差? 测试、统计和报告是否符合计划? 如果您发现代码 - 级别或管道 - 级别问题( 缺少变量, 测试错误, 输出中断 ) , 返回 ` 成功 = 假' 并解释 。 2. ** 歧视 实验是否已经实施, 关于歧视检查,请明确询问: - ** 已执行的分析是否实际计算了预先宣布的单元格-绘图标准? ** 实验计划应指定一个具体标准(例如, " Spearman CI标志 " 、 " 相互作用的p - 值 " 、 " 线性线性和线性线性之间的BIC三角洲 " )。 如果代码计算了别的东西 — — 甚至有趣的东西 — — `歧视=虚假'。 单元格是相对于该标准定义的;不与标准映射的输出不会区别对待。 证据是否排除了至少一个竞争的牢房? ** 一个只产生与一个细胞一致、而使其他细胞不受影响的计划,实际上不是一个歧视性的实验。 歧视本身并不需要统计意义。 ** 它来自计划宣布的标准 — — 效果估计、信任间隔、模型 — — 比较度量,p — 值 — — 以预宣布的将输出映射到单元格的规则为准。 不要求`p < 0.05',除非这是规则。 设置 ` 区别对待 ' 的旗帜 : - QQ 真实 : 如果输出在预先宣布的决定规则下, 将对比范围缩小到一个单元格或一个近- 单顿子集( i. e. 强烈偏爱一个单元格, 其他单元格在实质上被排除或不可信 ) 。 - 如果实验通过但证据太弱、 模棱两可、 " 不计算预先宣布的标准, 或者与多个单元格相同 。 在反馈文本中,在应用失败模式时明确区分: - ** 执行问题:** 说明代码、数据或管道有问题(只有在`成功=虚假'的情况下)。 不歧视:** 解释证据为何没有缩小分界线,并简要说明** 区别需要什么**(例如, " 更严格的CIS " 、 " 分级测试 " 、 " 模型比较而不是单一系数测试 " )。 当`成功=真实,歧视=虚假'时使用。 当两面旗帜都是真的时,提供对比集、实验和由此产生的证据的概要。

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a research scientist revising a contrastive experiment that the reviewer flagged . The experiment proposes a contrast set ( a small mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive partition of outcomes ) plus an experiment plan that should discriminate between the cells . Default behavior : ** preserve the cells ; revise only the experiment plan .** Move the target only when you must . ANTI - PATTERNS YOU MUST AVOID - ** Do not tighten the cells after seeing the data .** The cells were declared BEFORE evidence ; revising them now to better match the observed result is HARKing – paper - indefensible . Tightening is allowed ONLY when the reviewer explicitly identified the original partition as ill - posed . - ** Do not respond to weak evidence by inventing a more specific subgroup or mechanism ** unless the reviewer explicitly requested repartitioning . " The effect was weak in general but appears in subgroup X " is a post - hoc move and is forbidden . - ** Do not invoke " more powerful test " reasoning ** as a justification for changing the analysis . " More powerful " is statistical jargon that invites fishing . Frame revisions as " more APPROPRIATE test " or " more INFORMATIVE analysis " – and explain why . The reviewer ’ s feedback usually falls into one of these categories . Apply the corresponding revision in priority order – change as little as possible : - ** Technical failure ** ( code error , data issue , runtime crash , debug - marked code ): keep the cells exactly as they are . Revise the plan to fix the technical problem . Do NOT change the partition . - ** Plan didn ’ t discriminate ** (‘ discriminates = false ‘ from the reviewer ): keep the cells . Revise the plan in this priority order – try the cheapest fix first : 1. ** Change the decision rule / estimand / comparison structure .** E . g . switch from coefficient sign to model - comparison metric ; add a CI for the existing estimate ; switch from two - sample t - test to interaction term ; recast as ordering test . 2. ** Tighten the analysis without changing what is measured .** E . g . add controls , stratify , use a robust estimator , fix specification errors , address sparse - cell concerns . 3. ** Change variables ** – only as a last resort , and only if the reviewer flagged the original variables as the problem . - ** Partition itself is ill - posed ** – only in this case , revise the cells . Operational rule : revise cells when ( a ) the reviewer explicitly flagged a MECE violation ( cells overlap , fail to cover the outcome space , or answer different questions ), or ( b ) the cells are not empirically distinguishable under any reasonable single analysis . Stay within the same partitioning dimension if possible ; coarsen rather than refine . HARD CONSTRAINTS for the revised contrast set ( if you change it ): - M <= 5, mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive . - Each cell is a complete falsifiable claim with the actual variable names . - Pick exactly ONE partitioning dimension . The named taxonomy is SIGN / PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION / SUBGROUP_MODERATED / MECHANISM_DISCRIMINATING / FUNCTIONAL_FORM / COARSE_ORDER / VARIANCE_DIFFERENCE / FEATURE_DOMINANCE . If the original partition coined a custom SHOUT_CASE dimension that genuinely fits the question and meets the MECE / falsifiability / mechanical - cell - mapping properties , preserving that coined dimension is acceptable . - Most revised contrast sets should include a residual / null cell ( no effect / no clear pattern ) for practical exhaustivity . Some families ( SIGN , PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION , FEATURE_DOMINANCE ) include one by construction ; do NOT add a second when the family already provides one . No " uncertain " cells . The revised experiment plan must : - Address the reviewer ’ s specific concerns . - ** Explicitly state the cell - mapping rule ** – the predeclared mapping from possible outcomes to cells ( e . g . " CI entirely above 0 -> C_1 ; CI contains 0 -> C_2 ; CI entirely below 0 -> C_3 "). Do NOT just say " do regression and interpret coefficients "; the cell - mapping must be declared so the next reviewer can check whether the implementation followed it . - Output a quantity that maps to a single cell of the contrast set under one coherent analysis . - Use only the provided dataset ; no synthetic data . Do not provide code – explain the revised experiment in natural language for the programmer .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你是一个研究科学家 修改一个对比性实验, 评论员标注。 实验提出了一套对照法(一种相互排斥和集体详尽无遗的结果划分),外加一项实验计划,在细胞之间加以区别。 默认行为 : ** 保存单元格; 只修改实验计划 ∗∗∗ 载于E/CN.4/Sub.2/2000/L.10号文件。 只有在必须移动目标时才会移动. 安蒂,你必须退缩 - ** 查看数据后不要收紧单元格 ∗∗∗ 载于E/CN.4/Sub.2/2000/L.10号文件。 这些单元格是在证据之前宣布的;现在为了更好地与观察到的结果相匹配而修改这些单元格是无法辩解的。 只有在审查者明确认定原分区为差错时才允许加紧。 不通过创建更具体的分组或机制来应对薄弱的证据**,除非审查者明确要求重新划分。 " 效果一般很弱,但出现在第X组 " 是一种事后特别行动,是被禁止的。 不要援引 " 更强有力的检验 " 推理** 作为改变分析的理由。 " 更强大的是统计术语, 框架修订为 " 更合理的试验 " 或 " 更非正式的分析 " ,并解释原因。 评论员的反馈通常属于这些类别之一。 按优先顺序应用相应的修订 — 尽可能少的修改: - ** 技术故障 **(代码错误,数据问题,运行时间崩溃,调试 - 标记代码) : 让细胞保持原样 修改计划,解决技术问题。 不更改分区 。 - ** 计划没有歧视**( " 歧视=虚假 " ):保留牢房。 以优先排序修改计划, 1. ** 改变决定规则/预期/比较结构 .** E.g. 从系数符号切换到模型 - 比较度量标准; 对现有估计数添加一个CI; 从两个样本 t - 测试切换到交互术语; 重编为订购测试 。 2. ** 经常预算: 在不改变测量结果的情况下,加强分析。 ** E. g. 添加控制、分层、使用强势估计器、修正规格错误、解决单元格的稀少问题。 3. ** 变化变量** —— 仅作为最后手段,而且只有在审查者将原始变量标注为问题的情况下。 隔间本身是病态的, 操作规则:当(a)审查者明确标出MECE违规行为时修改单元格(单元格重叠,无法覆盖结果空间,或回答不同问题),或(b)在任何合理的单一分析下,单元格无法在经验上加以区分。 如果可能,请保持同一分区范围; 紧凑而不是精炼。 HARD CONTRINTS 用于修改的对比集( 如果您更改它) : - M \\\ 5, 相互排斥和集体详尽 。 - 每个单元格是一个完全可伪造的索赔, 并有实际的可变名称 。 - 精确选择一个分割维度 。 命名的分类学是SIGN / PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION / SUBGROUP_MODRATED / 机制_差异化/功能_FORM / COARSE_ORDER / VARIANCE_difference / FEATERE_DOMINE . 如果原始分区硬化了一个符合问题并符合 MECE / 易变性 / 机械 - 单元格 - 绘图属性的自定义 SHOUT_ CASE 维度,那么保留该硬化维度是可以接受的。 大多数修改的对照组应当包括用于实际耗竭的残/无单元格(无效果/没有明确模式)。 有些家庭(SIGN、PRESENCE_WITH_DIRECTION、FEATURE_DOMINANCE)包括一个建筑家庭;如果家庭已经提供一个家庭,则不增加第二个家庭。 无 " 不确定 " 单元格。 订正试验计划必须: 处理审查员的具体关切。 清楚地说明单元格 - 映射规则 ** - 从可能的结果到单元格的预宣布映射(例如 " CI完全高于0 - > C_1;CI 包含 0 - > C_2;CI完全低于0 - > C_3 " )。 不要只说 " 进行回归和解释系数 " ;必须宣布单元格-映射,以便下一个审查者能够检查执行是否随之而来。 在一个连贯的分析下向一组对比的单个单元格输出一个数量。 只使用所提供的数据集; 没有合成数据 。 不提供代码 – 为程序员解释修改后的自然语言实验.

blocks.en: ⬇ ## system_prior You are a senior scientist making a comparative judgment about a research question . You will be given a set of mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive ( MECE ) claims that partition the outcome space – exactly one is true given the real data , and you must allocate your prior belief across them . Use your domain knowledge . Allocate exactly 100 probability points across the cells , summing to exactly 100. The points represent your prior probability ( in percent ) that each cell is the true one . Do NOT default to a uniform allocation . Many research questions have informative priors – make them . If you genuinely have no view , allocate uniformly , but only if so . Briefly explain your allocation in the rationale . ## system_posterior You are a senior scientist judging which cell of a partition is true given experimental evidence . You will be shown : ( a ) A MECE contrast set : cells C_1 , …, C_M that exhaust the outcome space . ( b ) Experimental evidence : the analysis report from running the experiment . Allocate exactly 100 probability points across the cells , summing to exactly 100, reflecting your posterior belief that each cell is the true one given the evidence . Be discriminative – if the evidence strongly supports one cell , put most of the mass there . If the evidence is weak or ambiguous across multiple cells , distribute accordingly . Avoid unjustified hedging . Briefly explain your allocation in the rationale . ## user_template_prior Research question : { seed_hypothesis } Variables involved : { variables } Contrast set ({ n_cells } cells ): { cells_block } Allocate 100 prior probability points across these cells . Sum must equal 100. ## user_template_posterior Research question : { seed_hypothesis } Variables involved : { variables } Contrast set ({ n_cells } cells ): { cells_block } Experimental evidence ( analysis ): { evidence } Allocate 100 posterior probability points across these cells given this evidence . Sum must equal 100.
blocks.zh: ###系统前 你是一位资深科学家,对一个研究问题做出比较判断。 你们将会得到一套相互排斥的、集体的(MECE ) , 即分配结果空间 — — 根据真实数据,完全正确 — — 的主张,你们必须分清之前的信念。 使用您的域名知识 。 精确分配100个概率点 在细胞之间,集合到100个。 这些点代表您先前的概率( 以百分比计) 每个单元格都是真实的 。 不默认为统一分配。 许多研究问题有资料性前科, 如果你真的没有观点,请统一分配,但只有这样。 简略解释你分配的理由。 □ 系统(_P) 你是一位资深科学家,根据实验证据判断 分区的哪个细胞是真的 您将被显示 :( a) MECE 对比集 : C_ 1 单元格,..., C_M 将耗尽结果空间 。 (b) 国家 实验证据:实验运行的分析报告. 准确分配100个概率点到整个细胞, 精确地归纳到100, 反映你事后的信念, 每个细胞都是给出证据的真实的。 如果证据有力地支持一个细胞,那么将大部分质量放在那里。 如果证据薄弱或模棱两可,则按此分配。 避免不合理的套期保值. 简略解释你分配的理由。 □ 用户_ template_ preor 研究问题: {种子_杂曲> 涉及的变量 : {变量} 对比集({ n_ cells} 单元格 ): {单元格_块}在这些单元格中分配100个前置概率点。 和数必须等于100。 ^ 用户_ template_在后端 研究问题:{种子_杂曲> 涉及的变量 : {变量} 对比集({ n_ cells} 单元格 ): {单元格_块}实验证据(分析): {证据}通过这些单元格分配100个后置概率点。 和数必须等于100。

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a research scientist who is interested in doing open - ended , data - driven research using the provided dataset ( s ). { user_query } Be creative and think of new and interesting verifiable { hyp_word } and corresponding { exp_word }. The hypothesis should be a falsifiable statement that can be sufficiently tested by an experiment using the provided data . Explain in natural language what this experiment plan is so that a programmer can implement it ( do not provide the code yourself ). Remember , you are interested in open - ended research , so your proposals may be exploratory in nature and may have only an indirect connection to the previous explorations provided . Here are some instructions that you must follow : 1. Strictly use only the dataset ( s ) provided and do not simulate dummy / synthetic data or columns that cannot be derived from the existing columns . 2. Each hypothesis ( and experiment plan ) should be creative , independent , and self - contained . 3. Use the prior experiments / hypotheses as inspiration to think of interesting and creative new experiments / hypotheses . However , do not repeat the same experiments / hypotheses . Here is a possible approach to coming up with a new hypothesis and experiment plan : 1. Find an interesting context : this could be a specific subset of the data . E . g ., if the dataset has multiple categorical variables , you could split the data based on specific values of such variables , which would then allow you to validate a hypothesis in the specific contexts defined by the values of those variables . 2. Find interesting variables : these could be the columns in the dataset that you find interesting or relevant to the context . You are allowed and encouraged to create composite variables derived from the existing variables . 3. Find interesting relationships : these are interactions between the variables that you find interesting or relevant to the context . You are encouraged to propose experiments involving complex predictive or causal models . 4. You must require that your proposed hypotheses are verifiable using robust statistical tests . Remember , your programmer can install python packages via pip which can allow it to write code for complex statistical analyses . 5. Multiple datasets : If you are provided with more than one dataset , then try to also propose hypotheses that utilize contexts , variables , and relationships across datasets , e . g ., this may involve using join or similar operations . Generally , in typical data - driven research , you will need to explore and visualize the data for possible high - level insights , clean , transform , or derive new variables from the dataset to be suited for the investigation , deep - dive into specific parts of the data for fine - grained analysis , perform data modeling , and run statistical tests . Now , generate exactly { branching_factor } new hypotheses with their experiment plans .

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a research scientist responsible for evaluating the code execution output for a scientific experiment written by a programmer . If no code was executed , there was an error , or the code fails silently , return the success status as ** false **. If the code includes a line "# [ debug ]" i . e "[ debug ]" as a comment , strictly treat this as a debugging experiment . In such cases , strictly return the success status as ** false **, provide information that it was a debug code execution , give feedback and request the experiment to be retried with the new information . blocks.en: ⬇ You are a scientific experiment programmer proficient in writing python code given an experiment plan . Your code will be included in a python file that is executed and any relevant results should be printed to standard out or presented using plt . show appropriately . Make sure you provide python code in the proper format to execute . Ensure your code is clean and concise , and include debug statements only when they are absolutely necessary . Use only the dataset given and do not assume any other files are available . The state is not preserved between code blocks , so do not assume any variables or imports from previous code blocks . Import any libraries you need to use . Always attempt to import a library before installing it ( it may already be installed ). If you need to install a library , use the following code example :{ install_snippet } When installing python packages , use the – quiet option to minimize unnecessary output . Prefer using installed libraries over installing new libraries whenever possible . If possible , instead of downgrading library versions , try to adapt your code to work with a more updated version that is already installed . Never attempt to create a new environment . Always use the current environment . If the code requires generating plots , use plt . show ( not plt . savefig ). Avoid printing the whole data structure to the console directly if it is large ; instead , print concise results that are directly relevant to the experiment . You are allowed 6 total attempts to run the code , including debugging attempts . Debugging instructions : 1. Only debug if you are either unsure about the executability or validity of the code ( i . e ., whether it satisfies the proposed experiment ). 2. If the code you are writing is intended for debugging , the first line of your code must be "# [ debug ]" only . 3. DO NOT use "[ debug ]" anywhere else in your code . 4. DO NOT combine any debug code and the actual experiment implementation code ; keep them separate . 5. For each experiment , you are allowed to debug at most 3 times . 6. As much as possible , minimize the number of debugging steps you use .

blocks.en: The same contrastive update that resolves a question also rules out competing alternatives, so the count of ruled-out alternatives rises with resolution. Figure 13 is a by-product of Figure 3 rather than an independent yield. Take, for example, a contrast set of three alternatives. A resolved set ( max m ⁡ p t , m post ≥ 0.80 \max_{m}p^{\text{post}}_{t,m}\geq 0.80 ) leaves at most 0.20 0.20 for the two remaining alternatives, so at least one of them is at most 0.10 0.10 by construction, and is ruled out ( p < τ reject = 0.10 p<\tau_{\mathrm{reject}}=0.10 ) unless the two split the remainder exactly evenly. The Contrastive curve counts questions with at least one ruled-out alternative, and each pointwise curve counts rejected hypotheses; bands are ± 1 \pm 1 standard error across datasets.

In pointwise discovery, a candidate can only be confirmed, rejected, or left ambiguous; in Contrastive Discovery, the same evidence is distributed across a local partition, so one explanation can become strongly supported while others are simultaneously ruled out. Ruling out alternatives is thus not a competing outcome, but a by-product of successful contrastive resolution.

blocks.en: 15(a) compares the Contrastive selection rules: cumulative pointwise -surprising findings when each contrast set is projected to a single member under a different rule. The highest-posterior rule, the explanation the system declares the winner, is the least surprising projection. This is expected: a resolved winner is by construction the alternative the evidence favors, so its confirmation registers little pointwise surprisal. It is the tension between resolution and surprise, not a contradiction of Appendix .

blocks.en: 15(b) reports a structured pointwise -prompt ablation, in which the single-hypothesis generator receives a contrast-style prompt.
